capabilities: Convert every Excalidraw drawing in a vault to tldraw
Convert selected drawings, folders or the open drawing
Write a per-run report of what converted and what was left behind
Preserve layout, sizes, line weights, fills and outline colours
Skip already-converted drawings and never overwrite existing files
disambiguation: Not a tracing or overlay drawing tool; it converts Excalidraw drawing files into tldraw files.
extras: Makes no network requests and has no account or telemetry; built for mobile but only tested on desktop. Requires tldraw plugin 1.33.0 or newer; the Excalidraw plugin is not needed.
motivation: Built for people who started drawing in Excalidraw and now want those drawings in tldraw, where the only way across was copy and paste one drawing at a time.
problem: The only way to move drawings from Excalidraw to tldraw was copy and paste, one drawing at a time, so large collections stayed stranded.

relations.evidence: It runs tldraw's own Excalidraw importer, the same code behind paste, inside your installed tldraw plugin.

summary: Converts Excalidraw drawings across a vault into tldraw files, keeping layout, line weights, fills and colours, and leaving originals untouched.
